Plot DYNOT results

Source: R/plot_dynot.R
plot_dynot.Rd

The plot_dynot function plots the input data and the DYNOT noise model (median and confidence envelopes, reversed y-axis) as in the Acycle DYNOT window. Translated from the plotting part of Acycle v3.1 DYNOS.m (Mingsong Li).

Usage

plot_dynot(dynot_res = NULL, plot_data = TRUE, x_lab = "time (kyr)")

Arguments

dynot_res

DYNOT result to plot: the list returned by dynot (its data, percentile, interval_count and median_index elements are used). Required (Default=NULL gives an error).

plot_data

Also plot the input data in an upper panel above the noise model (logical, TRUE or FALSE); with FALSE only the noise panel (median and up to five confidence envelopes, reversed y-axis) is drawn. Default=TRUE.

x_lab

Label of the time axis of both panels (character). Default="time (kyr)".

Value

No return value; a plot is drawn.

References

Li, M., Hinnov, L.A., Huang, C., Ogg, J.G., 2018. Sedimentary noise and sea levels linked to land-ocean water exchange and obliquity forcing. Nature Communications 9, 1004. doi:10.1038/s41467-018-03454-y

Author

Michiel Arts (R translation); original MATLAB code: Mingsong Li (Acycle).

Examples

# \donttest{
set.seed(2)
t <- cumsum(runif(900, 1, 3))
x <- sin(2 * pi * t / 405) + sin(2 * pi * t / 41) + rnorm(900)
res <- dynot(data = cbind(t, x), n_sim = 20, n_out = 200, seed = 1)
plot_dynot(res)

# }
